description: Mechanical cross-check of central_bridge_triangle.md Parts II and IV: (1) the shared-external-neighbour configuration (a'=b'=w) genuinely forces a 4-cycle on an explicit gadget, confirming Lemma NE's mechanism independently of the hand proof; (2) a triangle-anchored central bridge B_x, built explicitly with an NPT theta Theta_x (poles {X_x, x'}) and a bridge component attached via the triangle's own edges, has attachment set exactly {x, X_x} and its shortest x-X_x path inside B_x is exactly length 2, with a genuine second path of length 3 or 4 (here 4) -- confirming Part IV.2's concrete ell=2 sharpening.
scope_note: Does not re-derive Gao-Huo-Liu-Ma, CB1, or CB3' (all cited by name). What is checked: the 4-cycle's existence on the shared-external-neighbour gadget, and, on the triangle-theta-bridge gadget, the attachment set (via networkx component/boundary computation on G minus Theta_x's vertex set) and the exact multiset of simple x-X_x path lengths inside the explicitly-constructed B_x subgraph (excluding Theta_x's own x-X_x edge, which is part of P0 and not of B_x) via networkx.all_simple_paths -- a fully independent mechanism from the hand derivation in the markdown file.
note_on_python_version: Same environment note as prior manifests: requirements.txt/.python-version pin CPython 3.14.6, unavailable in this container; this run used 3.13.12 with networkx==3.6.1 (matches requirements.txt's pin exactly).
detector_agreement: Both checks use networkx directly (node_connected_component/neighbors for the attachment-set computation, all_simple_paths for the exact path-length multiset), independent of this project's hand-rolled cycle checkers used elsewhere. 0 disagreements with the hand-derived predictions.
completed_range: Two small, deterministic illustrative gadgets (one per claim), not a search or census -- consistent with the phase's explicit decision not to launch broad computation.
